messages:
Elaine: Customer Jansen GmbH — invoice on hold because PO required + VAT reverse charge. They uploaded `resale_cert.jpg` but our OCR flagged a name mismatch. VIES lookup for VAT ID DE123456789 returns VALID. Can we do a manual override so customer can get the PO invoice?

Omar: Saw. Do we have the original PDF or a signed scan? The portal error is 'Legal name differs'. Can you paste the OCR output and any VIES proof?

Elaine: OCR returned: `Janssen GmbH` (extra 's') vs legal `Jansen GmbH`. Photo was a cropped phone pic. Customer provided a VIES screenshot and says the VAT ID is correct: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/ — they attached `vies_screenshot.png` and `resale_cert.jpg`.

Elaine: Repro steps for billing: 1) Upload resale_cert.jpg in billing portal -> 2) system runs OCR -> 3) validation check compares normalized names -> 4) fails name_similarity threshold -> 5) invoice moves to HOLD_PO and blocks issuance. Logs snippet:

```
ocr:
  raw_text: "Janssen GmbH"
  normalized: "Janssen GmbH"
  similarity: 0.76
  threshold: 0.80
validation: vat_id -> DE123456789 -> VIES: true
billing_action: set_status(HOLD_PO)
```

Omar: Thanks. If VIES shows the VAT ID is valid and country matches, our acceptance rule usually allows manual override. But finance needs to sign off. @Greg / finance-escalations can you approve a provisional reverse-charge override while we request a higher-quality scan from the customer? Customer wants the invoice with PO #7890 today.

Greg: Looping finance-escalations. We require either a signed PDF or a notarized resale certificate ideally, but if VIES is green we can grant a provisional override for a single billing cycle. Approving provisional override for INV-2026-00457, on condition customer provides clear PDF within 7 days. I'll log the decision and rationale. Marking: `approved-override/temporary`.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-00457 status changed: HOLD_PO -> PROVISIONAL_REVERSE_CHARGE_APPROVED by Greg at 1956789200.

Elaine: I'll notify the customer (Jansen) and attach the provisional invoice with the PO. Also requesting they re-upload a clean PDF. Will add the VIES screenshot and OCR output to the support ticket.

Greg: :thumbsup: Please include the raw VIES XML (or screenshot) and the OCR log in the file we store for audit. Also note why we accepted despite a 1-character name mismatch.

Omar: Operational follow-up: we should add a small product change — allow a support manual-override button when VIES verification passes, and/or relax the name-similarity threshold for DE/AT/NL when VAT ID checks out. Filing a ticket for infra/portal.

Elaine: Filed internal issue ENG-1234 (private) to add support override flow + audit fields. I'll update KB article: "Handling one-character OCR mismatches when VIES passes".

billing-bot: Update: Customer uploaded clearer PDF at 1956789400 and payment cleared -> Invoice INV-2026-00457 moved to PAID.

Omar: Great — please close the support ticket once the clean doc is attached and the reason-for-override notes are in the audit log.

Elaine: Closing after audit entry. Thanks all.
